elements.label: Ornate gap 3x3 frame
elements.notes: First ornate 3x3 UI frame variant. This is the gapped version; its corners and connectors work together as one closed set.

feedback.Interpretation: Part of the left-hand top-row family. This is the ornate 3x3 variant with visible gaps.
feedback.Missing related tiles: Reviewed as part of the same family as the adjacent ornate smooth 3x3 and the simple 2x2 frame.
feedback.Composition / usage notes: Use as a fixed 3x3 extensible frame variant. Its one-pixel extensions are part of how this specific set closes its gaps, so it should not be mixed with the smooth variant.
feedback.Action later (do not change yet): When semantic authoring is actioned, record its connector roles explicitly and link any exact duplicate connector placements rather than duplicating semantics.

elements.label: Ornate smooth 3x3 frame
elements.notes: Second ornate 3x3 UI frame variant. This is the smooth/no-gap version; it is a distinct closed set from the gapped variant.

feedback.Interpretation: Part of the left-hand top-row family. This is the ornate 3x3 variant without gaps.
feedback.Missing related tiles: Reviewed alongside the ornate gap 3x3 and simple 2x2 frame, but not interchangeable with them.
feedback.Composition / usage notes: Use as its own self-contained 3x3 frame. The closure logic differs from the gapped variant, so its connectors and corners should stay grouped with this style.
feedback.Action later (do not change yet): Capture its connector roles and any exact duplicate placements as linked uses, not copied semantics.

elements.label: Simple 2x2 frame
elements.notes: Compact 2x2 frame variant to the right of the ornate pair. Simpler corners; pairs with the gap-style connector logic rather than the smooth ornate variant.

feedback.Interpretation: Third member of the left-hand top-row family: a simple-corner 2x2 frame.
feedback.Missing related tiles: Treat as part of the same reviewed family as the two ornate 3x3s, but with its own corner style.
feedback.Composition / usage notes: The 2x2 lines up with the gap-connector family, not the smooth one. It is a separate compact frame variant, not just a crop of either ornate 3x3.
feedback.Action later (do not change yet): Record which connector family it is compatible with when the UI kit semantics are actioned.

elements.label: Less ornate gap 3x3 frame
elements.notes: First 3x3 of the right-hand top-row pair. Same broad family as its neighbor, but this is the gapped version with less ornate corners.

feedback.Interpretation: First member of the right-hand top-row pair: a less ornate 3x3 frame with gaps.
feedback.Missing related tiles: Reviewed as a pair with the adjacent less ornate smooth/no-gap 3x3.
feedback.Composition / usage notes: Working assumption from review: this pair behaves like the ornate pair, with a distinct gap variant and no-gap variant that should not be mixed.
feedback.Action later (do not change yet): Verify connector roles and exact duplicate placements before semantic promotion.

elements.label: Less ornate smooth 3x3 frame
elements.notes: Second 3x3 of the right-hand top-row pair. Less ornate corners, smooth/no-gap closure, and not interchangeable with the gapped partner.

feedback.Interpretation: Second member of the right-hand top-row pair: a less ornate 3x3 frame without gaps.
feedback.Missing related tiles: Treat as the paired smooth/no-gap variant of the adjacent less ornate gap 3x3.
feedback.Composition / usage notes: Do not treat this as interchangeable with the gap version; same family, different closure logic.
feedback.Action later (do not change yet): Verify exact connector matches against lower UI panel sets before collapsing any semantics.

elements.label: Menu corner and toggle marks
elements.notes: Three adjacent compact UI frame/widget clusters from the middle UI block; recut to include the full right edge of the third cluster.

elements.label: Cursor and small icon set
elements.notes: Includes the right-pointing menu cursor, a boxed variant, and nearby small symbols used in menus and stats screens.

elements.label: Separator and border run set
elements.notes: Long vertical and horizontal runs used as section dividers and border continuations inside larger panels and HUD layouts.

elements.label: Panel corner variants
elements.notes: A row of compact panel-corner and edge variants that look suited to smaller label boxes and inset panels.

elements.label: Panel variants and filler tiles
elements.notes: Compact frame fragments and fill/pattern tiles that may support smaller boxes, panel backgrounds, or ornamental insets.

elements.label: Wordmark and symbol row
elements.notes: Includes the minimal_8 wordmark row, curled symbol, boxy glyphs, and ornamental marks. Likely branding/decorative rather than panel construction.
